Here’s a single–change patch that will allow `!important` to be recognized whether or not there’s a space before it (i.e. drop the `\B` check and just look for `!important\b`):

```javascript
### components/prism-css.js
<<<<<<< SEARCH
    'property': /[-_a-z\xA0-\uFFFF][-\w\xA0-\uFFFF]*(?=\s*:)/i,
    'important': /\B!important\b/i,
    'function': /[-a-z0-9]+(?=\()/i,
=======
    'property': /[-_a-z\xA0-\uFFFF][-\w\xA0-\uFFFF]*(?=\s*:)/i,
    'important': /!important\b/i,
    'function': /[-a-z0-9]+(?=\()/i,
>>>>>>> REPLACE
```

Explanation:
- The original `/\B!important\b/i` would only match `!important` when it was *not* preceded by a word boundary—i.e. when there was whitespace or punctuation before the bang.  
- By changing it to `/!important\b/i`, we remove that restriction, so `!important` is recognized in all contexts (with or without a preceding space).
